evaluation_protocol.batch_rule: complete three valid pairs; candidate wins > losses; candidate median Elo > incumbent median Elo; zero invalid arms on either side
evaluation_protocol.representative_rule: median-ranked candidate artifact, tie-broken by pair index

search_control.phase_rule: test exactly two local rounds regardless of promotion; then test up to two distinct emergent capabilities; after two emergent non-promotions, keep counter-hypothesis mode until promotion

hypothesis_frontier.factor: Placement of independent terminal certification relative to the last permitted engine mutation
hypothesis_frontier.before: Independent verification precedes a mutating final integrator, so integration changes can reach emission without inspection by a non-authoring call.
hypothesis_frontier.after: The existing producer-verifier-integrator trajectory is followed by a distinct closure audit of the actual integrated engine; the final engine-producing call is a non-mutating gate that emits the integrated artifact only when that audit passes and otherwise emits the exact champion anchor engine.

hypothesis_frontier.factor: Allocation of terminal failure-to-delta causal attribution
hypothesis_frontier.before: The independent verifier supplies executable counterexamples or a no-failure certificate; the engine-producing integrator must itself infer which champion-to-provisional change caused a reported failure while deciding how to repair or roll it back.
hypothesis_frontier.after: The independent verifier must causally attribute every reported failure to an exact champion-to-provisional delta using reversible rollback interventions and emit an executable rollback certificate; the integrator may only preserve the provisional engine or apply those certified exact rollbacks.
hypothesis_frontier.evidence: matched batch 1W/0L/2T, median delta 15.115000000000009, candidate invalid count 0

hypothesis_frontier.factor: Recovery policy when executable causal interventions show that the provisional implementation has no safe exact-rollback path
hypothesis_frontier.before: The final integrator remains inside the provisional engine's change lineage: it may preserve that engine or apply verifier-certified exact rollbacks.
hypothesis_frontier.after: A causal-dead-end witness triggers a lineage reset: the final integrator discards the implicated provisional implementation, returns to the champion anchor, and constructs one alternative implementation of the same intended behavior under the verifier's executable constraints.
